name: Modern family house
description: Flat-roofed two-storey family house, 13 x 10 m plus an attached single garage and a rear timber terrace (16.5 x 13.5 m overall): brick-slip ground floor, white render and a vertical timber-clad stair bay above, large aluminium windows with precast sills, a steel entrance canopy, a parapet roof with aluminium coping. Enterable: sitting room, entrance hall and kitchen below, two bedrooms and a bathroom above, two stairs off the landing corridor; the garage opens from the kitchen.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
